_about: Documents the document collector (Unit 11) reads for metadata. A URL whose path ends in one of types' extensions, found by any source (web archives, page links, security.txt, registries), is retrieved once: in passive mode from a web archive's stored copy, so the target is never contacted, and in active mode from the target's own URL. format selects the offline extractor (pdf: the Info dictionary and XMP; ooxml: docProps/core.xml and app.xml). media_type is recorded as the File's type. max_bytes caps a download; a larger document is recorded without its metadata. Add types here, not in Go code; a new format needs an extractor.
